what: While loading, twenty coins drop one by one at .13s intervals from 200px above and 90px forward in the center of a background-color curtain (accelerating curve cubic-bezier(.4,0,.9,.42), 1.05s per coin), bounce back 8px and stack in four rows of five. They show a flat face while falling and switch to a side-view thickness at the moment of landing. Every 5 seconds the pile vanishes at 85~93% and stacks again, and the dots after ”Loading…” below grow in four beats over 1.4s. Pure CSS so it doesn’t stutter while heavy scripts run. On fx:hide the curtain lifts .5s after a .12s delay

options.hold: Show the curtain at least this long (ms) before lifting, default 0 — raise it if loading is so fast the dummy content can’t be seen
options.[data-fx-part=pile]: Coin pile board — if empty, lays down twenty coins
options.[data-fx-part=label]: (if present) text below — dots attach after it in four beats over 1.4s
options.fx:hide · fx:done: Fire it at the element to start the reveal (once) · the element fires fx:lift when it starts lifting and fx:done when fully lifted

use:
Loading
— When ready, el.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('fx:hide'))

from.where: index.html .dl-loader (coin pile overlay while the scene loads — original #loader · #pile · coindrop-0~19 · coinface/coinsolid · pilewipe · dots values as they are, coin graphics are our own SVG)
